note: Luf's battle suit. Only pieces with the whole body under them come off (docs/clothes-burst.md section 6): that is the skirt and what hangs on it. Stage 1 (a super lands on her): the outer layers - the front panel, the long ribbon on the left, the back panel with its fur hem, the ornaments and tassels. Stage 2 (her KO): the skirt itself (the long front and back panels with the band round the waist). Stays on: the top, collar, belt, gloves, panties (skin missing under them), shoes, hair ornaments. The first rule that matches a piece decides; pieces no rule matches stay on.
